responsibility: Implements the powerpc64le compatibility layer for Intel SSE2 intrinsics. It defines __m128i/__m128d types and a large set of inline MMX/SSE2 vector, scalar-double, load/store, shuffle, arithmetic, cache, and fence operations using AltiVec/VSX builtins and PowerPC idioms, enabling x86 SSE2-oriented source code to be retargeted through rs6000’s x86 intrinsic headers.
